title: Christmas Cocktails Clipart PNG Files
author: Design Owl
description:
Cocktails Clipart PNG files
Download these fun, Christmas cocktail recipe clipart designs, suitable for a range of possible product ideas including: Greeting cards, invitations, menus, recipe cards, digital papers, scrapbooking and more…
Includes 6 different cocktail illustrations!
Candy Cane
Ginerbread Martini
Holly Jolly
Poinsettia
Snowball
Mulled Wine
(Stars not included)
